question: What was remarkable about Abraham's obedience when God called him to go, according to Hebrews 11:8?
options: He took a large army with him
He went before he was called
He went with many camels and servants
He went even though he did not know where he was going
explanation: Hebrews 11:8 says by faith Abraham obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.
